title: mhtsec/ARTEX
why_read: An award-winning autonomous AI penetration-testing framework from a Chinese security competition, technically interesting for offensive security researchers but also a dual-use tool that needs careful framing.
analysis: ARTEX is described as an AI-driven autonomous penetration testing system that won a major Baidu-sponsored 'agent+' offense/defense competition, suggesting it integrates LLM agents into real exploitation and reconnaissance workflows. This is technically relevant to the growing field of agentic security tooling, where AI increasingly automates tasks traditionally done by human red teamers. It is legitimate security research tooling similar to other open pentesting frameworks, not inherently malicious, though as with any such tool there is dual-use risk if used against systems without authorization.
